name: Hariton Bogdanovich
source: Hariton is a balding, gray—haired old man with a long beard and metal crowns on his teeth. His small eyes are sly and thoughtful at the same time. After being attacked by a pack of mongrels, he was left paralyzed from the waist down and now has to use a wheelchair. He was wearing a plaid shirt, black trousers, and slippers.
